sections.title: Bringing things home takes another mission
sections.text: A return trip needs more spacecraft, fuel, and careful planning. NASA’s Mars Sample Return plans show that bringing even small samples home takes a separate mission with many steps. That work can add cost and complexity.

sections.title: Some places are historic science sites
sections.text: Apollo hardware and footprints help tell the story of exploration. NASA recommends protecting historic lunar artifacts so future visitors do not disturb their scientific and historic value.

sections.title: Spacecraft need a safe end-of-mission plan
sections.text: Spacecraft do not all end in the same way. NASA plans how to move spacecraft out of busy Earth orbits or into safe paths, helping protect future space missions. A Moon lander or a craft far beyond Earth has a different situation.
